battery: Every task was run twice through jdewitt.evaluation.grade_python: the reference solution must pass and a written mutant must fail. The suite was written only after both checks held for all tasks.
known_limits: English only; no multilingual code slice yet.
One task per family, so a per-family retention rate is a single sample.
The sandbox allowlist excludes file, network and eval, so this measures the pure-Python slice only.
scope: Authored single-function code tasks graded by executable assertions in the sandboxed pure-Python slice. Not benchmark items; difficulty is an authored ladder.
